# Lottie animations

- `lottie_light.min.js` — lottie-web 5.13.0 (light build, SVG only), MIT licence. https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web

The animations below are from LottieFiles free animations (Lottie Simple License), downloaded by the app's owner.
Authors and page links were not recorded; add them here if known.

| File | Original name | Changes | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `streak-flame.json` | Check-In Streak | Only the flame layers and the "flame grows" part are kept | Streak goes up |
| `cat-love.json` | Cat feeling love | None | Lesson quiz passed, session complete |
| `cat-laugh.json` | Cat laughing loudly | None | Level up, quest chest opened |
| `cat-sleep.json` | Cat is sleeping and rolling | White background layer removed | Review with nothing due |
| `dog-peek.json` | Flirting Dog | None | "Short on time?" link on Home |
| `robot.json` | Little power robot | None (colours flipped by CSS on the dark theme) | "AI is thinking" cards |

## Noto Emoji Animation

`noto-100.json`, `noto-muscle.json`, `noto-trophy.json` are from Noto Emoji Animation by Google
(https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-animation/), licence CC BY 4.0
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Unchanged. The credit is also shown at the bottom of the Me screen.
Used for: daily goal reached, weekly goal met, mock exam passed.
